Let's keep this quick, since a few of us have the client demo at ten thirty."], ["A", "Yesterday, we closed out eleven of the fourteen tickets in the sprint backlog, so only three are still open, and we're in pretty good shape."], ["A", "Those three are all related to the payment module."], ["A", "Minh found the root cause of the checkout bug last night, so that fix should be merged by noon."], ["A", "The bad news is that the staging server went down again at around two a.m."], ["A", "Operations says it's a disk space issue and they're on it, but they can't give us an exact time."], ["A", "So, if you were planning to test on staging this morning, you might want to hold off."], ["A", "Use your local environment for now, and I'll post in the team channel once it's back."], ["A", "One more thing: the sprint review has been pushed from Thursday to Friday at three, because the product owner is traveling."], ["A", "That actually gives us an extra day, which we definitely need."], ["A", "If anyone's blocked, grab me right after this call rather than waiting until the afternoon."], ["A", "Okay, that's it from me. Over to you, Minh."]], {"A": "F-AU"}]
